# Nexariza AI

> Nexariza AI is an AI engineering company founded by Ahmad Yasin. It builds production AI systems, AI employees and automation platforms for organizations in North America, Europe, the GCC and Asia-Pacific.

Ahmad Yasin is the Founder & CEO of Nexariza AI, an AI engineer and AI systems architect. Expertise: computer vision, LLM and RAG systems, agentic AI, speech and NLP, full-stack deployment.
